annotations.title: List AI image and video models

description: List the AI models of MakeViral Create (makeviral.ai/create): image models (Nano Banana, GPT Image, Seedream, Flux...) and video models (Seedance, Kling, Veo, Wan, Grok Imagine, MiniMax...) with what each takes and its lowest price in MakeViral credits. Use it when the user asks MakeViral for an image or a video from their own idea (not a trend template), wants a specific model such as Kling, Veo or Seedance, or asks which MakeViral model to use. Then use get_model for one model's full rules and prices, and create_image or create_video to make it.
